scope: Same80 exposed development problems; 540 qualified source choices. No heldout/autonomous result. Source styles and joint selection compared at fixed7/8bits.
candidate_selection: Seed each coherent scope/role/scope-arrow source style with 8 AST and 8 encoded-span proposals; exact marginal admission. Then screen all old and new seeds with joint source selection, refine best2 distinct per width with 12 AST and12span candidates, exact deletions, swaps and pairs.
admission: 96 counted ASCII/newline entries; AST<=512bytes with >=2 distinct problem owners across qualified alternatives; no full solve/function-body entries, parameter expansion or escapes.
results: Save fixed-style seeds, every attempted/rejected move, source-only screening, winning packets and receipt identities. Separate source-only, dictionary-only and joint gains; report fallback and storage alongside input.
